extDescription.message: Translate from your browser’s address bar and keep your place on the page.

regionalDialectsDesc.message: Choose which specific variant to use when typing short codes (e.g., 'zh' → 'zh-TW').

dragToReorder.message: Drag to reorder fallback priority (top = first to try)

noServicesEnabled.message: No services enabled. Enable at least one service to use translations.

storageDesc.message: Choose where to store your settings, including languages, instances, server URLs, API keys, translation order and copying preference.

credentialStorageWarning.message: API keys, tokens, and other credentials you save are stored as plain text in your browser profile. Anyone who gains access to that profile may be able to read and use them without your permission.

storageSyncWarning.message: All settings and credentials sync through your browser account. Local server URLs may refer to different services on another device.

storageLocalHint.message: All settings stay on this device. Previously synced settings remain available to other devices.

storageChangeFailed.message: Could not finish changing settings storage. The active setup is shown; retry to continue.

privacyDesc.message: Bar Translator collects no usage analytics. Text is sent to the enabled translation providers in your chosen order. API keys are sent to their provider for translation and validation.

footerUsage.message: Type t hello to translate with your saved source and target languages. Optional: t fr hello translates to French.

omniboxFirefoxPrompt.message: Translation appears below when ready. Wait for the result before pressing Enter to copy.

omniboxSuggestion.message: Type text to translate with your saved languages. <dim>Optional shortcut: fr Hello → French.</dim>

omniboxTranslating.message: <dim>Translating... Wait for the result before pressing Enter.</dim>

omniboxCopyFailed.message: Could not copy the translation. Please try again.

permissionCheckFailed.message: Could not check access. Please retry.

permissionDenied.message: Access was not granted. Try again to enable this feature.

permissionRemoveFailed.message: Could not remove access. Please retry.

settingsSaveFailed.message: Could not save settings. Please retry.

permissionChangeFailed.message: Could not change access. Please retry.

keyChangedDuringTest.message: API key changed. Test the current key again.

keyTestFailed.message: Could not test this key. Check the key, access, and connection, then retry.

copySettingsDesc.message: Choose whether Enter copies a completed translation. This preference follows your storage choice; clipboard access must be granted on each device.

settingsLoadFailed.message: Could not load settings. Please retry.

instanceChanged.message: This instance changed. Review its current settings and retry.

endpointDescription.message: Use a base URL, including its port and path prefix if needed.

httpEndpointWarning.message: HTTP sends translation text and any API key without encryption.

endpointKeyReset.message: Save the new endpoint before entering its API key.

saveBeforeTesting.message: Save changes before testing or changing activation.

instanceTestDescription.message: Testing sends a fixed sample request. It is optional and does not enable or disable this instance.

setupConflictDesc.message: Different setups are saved. Choose the saved setup or replace it with your current setup. Credentials are included, but are not shown here.

providerLanguageUnsupported.message: This instance does not support the requested language pair

providerTextTooLong.message: This instance cannot accept text of this length

omniboxCopyPermissionRequired.message: Copying needs permission on this device — Open settings

instanceEndpointInvalid.message: Use a complete HTTP or HTTPS base URL without credentials, a query or a fragment.

setupMigrationPending.message: Could not finish updating your saved settings. Your previous setup is still active. Retry before editing.

googleProviderDescription.message: Google’s web service. No API key required.

lingvaProviderDescription.message: A public translation proxy. No API key required.

deepLProviderDescription.message: Use your API key; keep accounts as separate named instances.

libreProviderDescription.message: Use the managed service or connect your own server.

newInstanceDescription.message: Save for later keeps this service off and does not contact the provider. Add and enable requests browser access; it does not test credentials.

customConnectionDescription.message: Turning on an existing custom server or granting access checks its connection without sending text or a key. Allow local-network access if asked.

customConnectionFailed.message: Connection to $1 could not be confirmed. If prompted, allow local-network access for this browser, then use Test to try again.

servicesWorkflowDesc.message: Only enabled instances receive text. They are tried from top to bottom; drag or use the arrows to reorder. If one fails, the next may receive the same text.

draftTestDescription.message: Test checks the current values without saving or enabling the service.
